sources.title: Don't upload your sensitive files to AI services: 4 free open-source ...
sources.snippet: AI apps usually work online, which means you have to give up your files and data to the cloud in order to use them. But these four open-source AI tools are completely offline and only use your computer's processing power to run. Handy Accurate speech-to-text transcription This is a free and open-source speech-to-text tool that uses local AI models.
